name: Inescapable Shadows
source:
A student living in modern Tokyo becomes entangled with the yakuza and is gradually pulled into their deals, rivalries, and violence.

As their involvement deepens, so do their relationships with the people surrounding the criminal underworld. Caught between loyalty, romance, and their own survival, the choices they make ultimately determine where they stand and who they consider an ally.
